[F#m]stop dreaming of the quiet life, 'cause it's the
[Em]one we'll never know And

[Em]rosy days are few And

[Bridge]
[G]stop apologizing for the
[F#m]things you've never done 'Cause
[A]time is short and life is cruel but it's
up to us to change This town called

[Chorus]
[D]malice

[F#m]Rows and rows of disused milk floats stand
[Em]dying in the dairy yard And a
[F#m]hundred lonely housewives clutch empty
[Em]milk bottles to their hearts

[Bridge]
[G]Hanging out their old love letters
[F#m]on the line to dry It's e-
[A]nough to make you stop believing when
tears come fast and furious In a town called

[Chorus]
[D]malice, ye-
eah!

[Em]Bababababa woah!
[F#m]Bababababababa
[Em]Bababababa

[Bridge]

[F#m]year after year The
[A]atmosphere's fine blend of ice, I'm
almost stone cold dead In a town called

[Chorus]
[D]malice, uu-
yeah!

[Verse 4]
[C#m]Whole street's belief in
[Bm]Sunday's roast beef Gets
[C#m]dashed against the
[Bm]Coop To either

[Bridge]

big decision in a town called malice,

[Chorus]
[D]ooh
yeah!

[Interlude]
[D]

[Verse 5]
[F#m]Ghost of a steam train,
[Em]echoes down my track
[F#m]It's at the moment bound for nowhere
[Em]Just going round and round, oh

[Bridge]
[G]Playground kids and creaking swings
[F#m]Lost laughter in the breeze I could
[A]go on for hours and I probably will But I'd
sooner put some joy back In this town called
